added_lines: . - memories & mementoes scrapbooking course 6 weeks starting thursday 22nd october 7–9pm €30 for 6 weeks. - free high-vis vests available at reception. - beekeeping for beginners 6 week course starting saturday 7th november 11am- 1pm. sympathy it was with sadness that we lost three of our more senior members of the parish. john duffy, aughatubrid, gleneely passed away in oakleaves nursing home. our deepest sympathy to his wife claire; his sons noel, alan & declan; his daughters, beatrice, geraldine, martina & dolores; his grandchildren, zoe, orla, emer, oisin, cara, aoife, lara, ciara, erin and fiadh; brother pat and sisters, bridie, peggy and sadie and the wider family circle. john’s funeral mass was in steelstown and burial in bocan cemetery. we also bade farewell to donal and patrick mclaughlin, falmore, gleneely . they were two of life's gentlemen. they lived a quite, simple life, filled with hard work, and the speed of their passing, shocked his close friends and neighbours. their devotion to their faith guided their lives. we offer our deepest sympathy to michelle, oliver and michaela who looked after them devotedly. donal and patrick’s funeral mass and burial was in ballinacrea. may god receive them home to their etern al reward. culdaff
priest wednesday – friday: 9am – 3pm rev. declan mcgeehan p. p./adm.
